title: Month 2, Week 2 (Dec 13 – Dec 19, 2026): Uncertain Diff, Small Round Cell Sarcomas, Sinonasal & Bone Tumors I

days.b1:
Retrieval (15m): Write out the 5-entity Deep Myxoid Soft Tissue Tumor table (vasculature, IHC, and translocations).
Reading (75m): WHO 5th Ed. — Uncertain Differentiation: Synovial Sarcoma (Monophasic/Biphasic; SS18::SSX1/2/4, SS18-SSX+, TLE1+), Epithelioid Sarcoma (Proximal vs. Distal; INI1 loss, ERG+, CD34+ in 50%!), Alveolar Soft Part Sarcoma (ASPSCR1::TFE3, TFE3+, PAS-D crystals), Clear Cell Sarcoma (EWSR1::ATF1, S100/SOX10/HMB45+), DSRCT (EWSR1::WT1), & PEComa.
days.b2:
Spot Slides (15m): 5 slides @ 3m/case (Biphasic & Monophasic Synovial Sarcoma, Distal Epithelioid Sarcoma mimicking granuloma annulare, ASPS, Clear Cell Sarcoma).
QBank (30m): 15 Uncertain Differentiation MCQs.
days.b3: SOE Deliverable: Log the classic pitfall: Distal Epithelioid Sarcoma on the hand/wrist of a young adult mimicking Necrobiotic Granuloma / SCC (Pan-CK+, EMA+, CD34+ [50%], ERG+, INI1 LOST!).

days.b1:
Retrieval (15m): Recall the 6 major INI1 (SMARCB1)-deficient neoplasms (AT/RT, Epithelioid sarcoma, Renal medullary carcinoma, Epithelioid MPNST, Myoepithelial carcinoma, SMARCB1-deficient sinonasal carcinoma).
Reading (75m): WHO 5th Ed. — Undifferentiated Small Round Cell Sarcomas: Ewing Sarcoma (EWSR1::FLI1/ERG, membranous CD99+, NKX2.2+), Round Cell Sarcoma with EWSR1-non-ETS fusions (EWSR1::NFATc2), CIC-rearranged Sarcoma (CIC::DUX4, WT1+, ETV4+, patchy CD99), & BCOR-altered Sarcoma (BCOR::CCNB3, BCOR+, SATB2+, TLE1+).
days.b2:
Spot Slides (15m): 5 slides @ 3m/case (Ewing sarcoma, CIC-rearranged sarcoma, BCOR sarcoma, DSRCT desmoplastic stroma, Undifferentiated Pleomorphic Sarcoma [UPS]).
QBank (20m): 15 Small Round Blue Cell Tumor MCQs.
days.b3: SOE Deliverable: Study One-Pager 2 (Undifferentiated Small Round Cell Sarcoma IHC & Molecular Matrix).

days.b1: Retrieval (15m): Draw the Small Round Blue Cell Tumor IHC & Translocation matrix from memory (Ewing, CIC, BCOR, Alveolar RMS, DSRCT, Mesenchymal Chondrosarcoma).
days.b2:
Slide Sprint (60m): 10 Timed Virtual Slides: 6 Soft Tissue Round Cell slides (3m/case) + 4 Cervical Pap smears (Bethesda: ASC-H, SCC, AGC, Endocervical AIS feathering/rosettes @ 6m/case).
QBank (45m): 20 Soft Tissue & Gyn Cyto MCQs.
days.b3: SOE Deliverable: Log Bethesda cytologic criteria for Endocervical Adenocarcinoma In Situ (AIS) (Pseudostratified strips, nuclear feathering, rosettes, cigar-shaped hyperchromatic nuclei, apical mitoses/apoptoses).

days.b1: Secondary System — Sinonasal Tract & Nasopharynx (90m): WHO Head & Neck 5th Ed. — Sinonasal Papillomas (Inverted EGFR, Oncocytic KRAS, Exophytic HPV 6/11); Sinonasal Round/Undifferentiated Tumors: Olfactory Neuroblastoma (Hyams grade, S100+ sustentacular, Calretinin+, Synaptophysin+), SNUC (IDH2 R172 mut!), SMARCB1- & SMARCA4-deficient carcinomas, NUT Carcinoma (BRD4::NUTM1, abrupt keratinization), Biphenotypic Sinonasal Sarcoma (PAX3::MAML3, S100+/SMA+), Glomangiopericytoma (nuclear β-catenin+), & Nasopharyngeal Carcinoma (EBER+).
days.b2: QBank & Slides (30m): 15 Sinonasal/Nasopharyngeal MCQs + 5 Spot Slides (Inverted papilloma, Olfactory neuroblastoma, NUT carcinoma, Nasopharyngeal carcinoma, Glomangiopericytoma).
days.b3: SOE Deliverable: Study One-Pager 4 (Sinonasal Small Round Blue Cell & Undifferentiated Tumor Panel) and log it in your SOE Log.

days.b1: Retrieval (15m): Blank-sheet recall of Sinonasal Undifferentiated & Small Round Cell Tumors (IHC and defining gene fusions/mutations).
days.b2:
QBank Sprint (60m): 30 Timed MCQs (15 Soft Tissue/Sinonasal + 15 2015–2023 Trainee Recalls on Soft Tissue & Sinonasal/Nasopharynx).
Deep Review (45m): Audit every recall distractor.
days.b3: SOE Deliverable: Log missed Soft Tissue & Sinonasal recall questions into the 4-Domain SOE Log.

days.b2: (Optional) 30m review of Week 2 SOE Log entries.
days.b3: Click Push to sync Week 2 of Month 2 to GitHub.

days.b1: Primary System Deep Dive — Bone & Cartilage Tumors Part 1 (2.5h): WHO 5th Ed. — Mandatory Radiologic-Pathologic Correlation (Epiphyseal vs. Metaphyseal vs. Diaphyseal); Cartilage Tumors: Osteochondroma (EXT1/2, cap >2 cm = secondary chondrosarcoma), Enchondroma vs. Chondrosarcoma Grades 1–3 (IDH1/2 mut, cortical permeation/host lamellar bone entrapment), Mesenchymal Chondrosarcoma (HEY1::NCOA2); Bone-Forming Tumors: Osteoid Osteoma vs. Osteoblastoma (FOS/FOSB+), Conventional Osteosarcoma, & Parosteal Osteosarcoma (MDM2 amp!).
days.b2: Slides & QBank (90m): 12 Bone Tumor Spot Slides @ 3m/case (Osteochondroma, Enchondroma vs. Chondrosarcoma permeative growth, Mesenchymal chondrosarcoma, Osteoid osteoma, Conventional & Parosteal osteosarcoma) + 25 Bone MCQs.
days.b3: SOE Deliverable (30m): Study One-Pager 3 & run a 10m SOE recording on Enchondroma vs. Grade 1 Chondrosarcoma / Atypical Cartilaginous Tumor emphasizing radiology and host bone entrapment.
